Generic Without prejudice to Buyer’s right to price adjustment by way of discount or any other right or remedy available to Buyer, Buyer may terminate the Contract or any part thereof by a written notice to the Seller, if: i) The Seller fails to comply with any material term of the Contract. ii) The Seller informs Buyer of its inability to deliver the Material(s) or any part thereof within the stipulated Delivery Period or such inability otherwise becomes apparent. iii) The Seller fails to deliver the Material(s) or any part thereof within the stipulated Delivery Period and/or to replace/rectify any rejected or defective Material(s) promptly. iv) The Seller becomes bankrupt or goes into liquidation. v) The Seller makes a general assignment for the benefit of creditors. vi) A receiver is appointed for any substantial property owned by the Seller. vii) The Seller has misrepresented to Buyer, acting on which misrepresentation Buyer has placed the Purchase Order on the Seller. 8. Generic While generating invoice in GeM portal, the seller must upload scanned copy of GST invoice and the screenshot of GST portal confirming payment of GST. 9. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 1 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training,

Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 10. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses a) All bidders are to mandatorily upload the following certificates/declarations as part of their bid: - (i) Technical Datasheet of Product (with make and model) (ii) Technical Compliance Declaration (with deviations if any clearly stated) (iii) Bid security declaration (iv) Bidder financial standing (v) Non disclosure certificate (v)i OEM authorisation certificate (vii) Acceptance of Bid T&C (viii) MSME certificate (pertaining to tender category only) (ix) MII declaration (duly mentioning percentage of local contents of the bidder). (b) All bidders are to mandatorily upload the following financial documents as part of their bid: - (i) OEM Average Turnover (Last 3 Years) (ii) Bidder Average Annual Turnover certificate (Last 3 Years) (iii) Scanned copies of PAN Card (iv) GSTIN certificate (v) Cancelled Cheque (vi) EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. If any firm fails to upload required documents within the date of bid opening, it will be liable for disqualific ation. (c) Bidders are to submit duly filled and signed Technical Compliance Declaration, of the offered product in comparison with Bid Specifications Document. Any deviation with the technical parameters, Materials used , Sub-assemblies, Test Procedures, Optical/Mechanical/Electrical Characteristics and Warranty of 12 month s etc from date of supply should be clearly indicated at the time of bidding. (d) Format of Bid Security Declaration in place of Bid Security is as follows:- "We, (Name of the Bidder/ Fir m), hereby accept that, if we withdraw or modify our bids during the period of validity, or if we are awarde d the contract and we fail to sign the contract, or to submit a performance security before the deadline def ined in the Tender/ Bid documents, we will be suspended for a period of six months and will not be eligible to submit Bids/ participate in any further Tenders issued by the Tender Inviting Authority during that perio d. (e) Format for Acceptance of Bid T&C is as follows : "We, (Name of the Bi dder/ Firm), hereby accept that, we have read and understood the complete bid document and hereby sub mit our acceptance to the Term s and Conditions, as well as ATC specified in the Bid document.". (f) Details of the product offered viz Technical Parameters, List of Deliverables/Scope of Work, Make and M odel, Inspection Criteria, etc should be uploaded along with the bid. (g) Inspection against approved drawing /QAP. Inspection charges will be borne by the seller. PSPP 04 lots. (h) Quality Assurance Document - Document No QAD-R03/latest QAD issued by Directorate of Quality Assu rance (Warship Project and Naval), New Delhi available at https://www.dgqadefence.gov.in will be the refer ence document for QA. (i) Total delivery period for the item in each lot is 180 days. Timelines to be followed will be as follows:- Ite m to be submitted for inspection within 140 days of order placement. Probable duration for inspection is 3 0 days. In case delay in inspection beyond 30 days, DP will be refixed accordingly. Item to be dispatched wit hin 10 days of issue of I-note.

(j) Quote TOV should include Basic Rates, GST, Custom Duty (IF APPLICABLE), Inspection/Testing charges ( if applicable) and all other relevant costs. There is no provision on GeM to increase the value of commerci al bid once bids are opened. (k) L1 firm is to supply the items and ensure following documents are dispatched along with the item at th e time of delivery: i) Inspection note copy ii)Tax Invoice iii) Guarantee Warranty certificate Note: Items to be delivered at consignee place between 9.00 hrs to 12. 00 hrs on working days only.
